brief_summary: Four numbered panels showing the order of operations for building a frankenswitch: pick the host housing for its acoustic shell, source the donor part, test-fit a single switch for pole spacing and wobble, then bench-test a small batch before scaling to a full board.
data_sources: frankenswitching-explained.mdx § 'Building one' — 'Pick the host housing first, usually for its acoustic shell ... Source the donor part next ... Before opening every switch on the bench, test-fit one donor part into one host housing and check for binding or play ... Only after that single pairing feels right does the swap scale to a full board's worth of switches'
